prose:
A Techmeme excerpt of Financial Times reporting describes a Wednesday technology selloff, with the Nasdaq 100 down more than 4%, Nvidia and Anthropic more than 9%, Broadcom about 7% and Micron about 11%. The excerpt frames the move as a continuation of the AI-linked equity unwind.

The full FT page timed out, so these are feed-level, evolving session figures rather than independently checked closing prices. The excerpt does not establish that one factor caused every move or what later trading will do. Price declines and a broad AI narrative are not enough to infer company solvency, a finalized credit rating or future returns.
highlights: Figures come from a secondary feed excerpt
Nasdaq 100 is distinct from the Nasdaq Composite
Values are not verified closing prices
Sector narrative is not a causal study
No investment or solvency conclusion is implied
